# iTelematics®

> iTelematics Software Private Limited (Bangalore, India) runs the Space Station Digital Twin R&D Center: long-term engineering and scientific research into physics-based, data-driven digital twins for future space stations, with an initial specialisation in Station Energy & Health Intelligence. Tagline: "Engineering the Intelligence Behind Future Space Stations." It does not build or operate space stations. The work builds on foundational spacecraft research, Satellite Energy & Telemetry Intelligence, around one question: can the satellite generate, store and manage sufficient energy to safely accomplish its mission?

Research results are labelled by maturity (Concept, Research, Simulation, Prototype, Experimental, Validated, Planned). Nothing on the site is flight-qualified or an operational digital twin, and reference values are simulated, not flight data. A fuller, citable summary is in [llms-full.txt](https://itelematics.com/llms-full.txt).

## Main pages

- [Space Station Digital Twin R&D](https://itelematics.com/space-station): vision (2047), mission, goals and proposed milestones; twelve space station systems with their physics, interfaces, telemetry and digital twin opportunities; an interactive model of a conceptual station (Station Reference Case SRC-1) with a simulated solar-channel fault and load-priority response; a competency pathway; six R&D programmes (two active priorities: station power and energy, station health monitoring); deliverables with their status; flagship experiments; competency pathways, a research roadmap and frequently asked questions
- [Research Lab](https://itelematics.com/research-lab): Space Station Digital Twin Research Lab: the practical R&D environment, station R&D programmes and research participation; includes the Space Digital Twin (five interactive 3D experiences: a satellite, an orbital constellation, a spacecraft, a space station, and Space Station Electrical Power & Energy Management, a guided investigation of a conceptual station's power system with ten subsystem topics and three simulated fault investigations; built on physics-based and mathematical models driven by simulated data; AI health monitoring and cybersecurity are planned) and the foundational spacecraft reference case, Satellite Energy & Telemetry Intelligence: orbit, energy, telemetry, fault scenarios, equations and engineering evidence with maturity labels
- [Engineering Ecosystem](https://itelematics.com/partners): Gamyaa AeroSystems, APEX Rocket Systems (proposed, concept stage), UFlight™ (aerospace health and usage monitoring), iFab Innovations (engineering & innovation ecosystem; no partnership claimed), EV Society™ and EV.ENGINEER™, each relationship described as it stands
- [Consultancy & Services](https://itelematics.com/consultancy): engineering consultancy, workshops and resources offered alongside the research
- [Contact](https://itelematics.com/contact): opens an email draft to info@iTelematics.com for space station R&D, Research Lab, research, academic, industry, consultancy and investment enquiries

## Engineering resources

- [Satellite Engineering reference](https://aerospace.ev.engineer/space/satellite-engineering): spacecraft architecture on EV.ENGINEER™ around a 6U Earth-observation reference mission
- [Interactive 3D Satellite](https://aerospace.ev.engineer/space/satellite-engineering/interactive-3d): interactive model of satellite subsystems
